accepted_findings.title: Audited manuscript boundary is closed
accepted_findings.summary: The rendered five-page paper passed all 13 mentor-comment traceability checks. This closes the audited manuscript boundary only and excludes later conference-template packaging.

accepted_findings.title: Paper-defined system boundaries are accepted as bounded context
accepted_findings.summary: The paper defines an authorized catalogue substrate, resolution-or-decline behavior, bounded and inspectable context, render-before-explain operation, anatomical orientation, and separation of visible evidence from unsupported inference. These are context for future work, not assertions that every behavior is implemented in code.

accepted_findings.title: Evaluated agent workflow reliability improved under the frozen skill
accepted_findings.summary: For the evaluated Codex and Claude product configurations, complete-workflow pass rates increased from 60.7% to 81.3% and from 78.7% to 90.7%, respectively. The result is limited to the tested prompts, products, models, orchestration, and backend revision and does not establish learning benefit or universal model quality.

accepted_findings.title: Total anatomy region cap is enforced
accepted_findings.summary: Executor commit 64a69a82 enforces the 60-part total focus-plus-context cap with deterministic near-limit regression coverage, and the independent evaluation passed all six acceptance conditions.

accepted_findings.title: Timing-bearing command evidence needs semantic corroboration
accepted_findings.summary: Recorded transcript hashes remain immutable original evidence, while independent reruns corroborate timing-sensitive test and build claims through explicit semantic observations rather than false byte-equality claims.

decisions.title: Accept validated paper context into knowledge-state v2
decisions.summary: The owner approved the validated paper context at 2026-09-03T04:29:08Z as bounded, non-authoritative project knowledge without expanding paper claims into code implementation truth.

decisions.title: Accept semantic observations plus independent reruns
decisions.summary: Timing-bearing transcript hash variance is accepted only with exact original evidence preservation, explicit semantic observations, and independent reruns.

decisions.title: Onboard Anatomed within control-artifact boundaries
decisions.summary: The owner selected Anatomed before onboarding, with pre-execution ownership limited to .mozak and application changes limited to the released executor packet.

reusable_patterns.title: Validate packet, result, and evaluation as one production bundle
reusable_patterns.summary: A self-contained PF-0006 bundle closes execution truth only after packet freshness, result receipt, complete evidence mapping, and evaluator independence validate together.

reusable_patterns.title: Connect anatomy notes to inspectable spatial evidence
reusable_patterns.summary: A future note-integration path may connect conceptual, functional, and clinical material to inspectable 3D renders while preserving query, explanation, render, provenance, and evidence boundaries. This is a direction and reusable design pattern, not a live integration claim.

reusable_patterns.title: Close planning with an exact successor DAG
reusable_patterns.summary: Record completed implementation, execution, and evaluation goals in a consecutive plan version with explicit per-goal supersession and unchanged dependency provenance.

open_gaps.title: Paper context is not live-synchronized
open_gaps.summary: The accepted context is an immutable snapshot pinned to source revision 392662303f926206cfaf943ed97f84d7e61bcd7f. Changes require a successor research run, input set, context version, and goal.

open_gaps.title: Learning benefit and broad anatomical correctness remain unproven
open_gaps.summary: The paper supports bounded deployability and evaluated agent-workflow findings, not learning outcomes, examination performance, patient-safety benefit, or broad anatomical correctness.

open_gaps.title: Portable external-project harness discovery
open_gaps.summary: The integration harness currently assumes Anatomed is a sibling checkout. Configurable or packaged fixture discovery remains deferred and the release makes no broader portability claim.

implementation_state.summary: The provenance-pinned context descriptor and note are present, the validated paper research inputs are accepted, and goal-dag-v8 records the onboarding goal as completed. This state describes context onboarding only and makes no claim that paper-described product behaviors or note synchronization are implemented.
Audited research, accepted inputs, successor goal DAG, execution bundle, friction dispositions, and accepted release state are recorded.
The bounded executor change is committed and its packet, result, and independent evaluation pass the production PF-0006 bundle contract.
